content_sections.heading: CAEPHT Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. CAEPHT/AICRP/PEASEM/SRF/26-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CAEPHT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's degree in Soil & Water Engg. / Masters in Horticulture with 4 years of bachelor's degree having first division or 60% marks or equivalents overall grade point average; Candidates having post-graduate degree with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have NET qualification and 2 years of research experience as mentioned in OM No. Edn./6/27/2014/-HRD dated 13th July 2015, OM No. Agril. Edn 6/27/2014-HRD 9th October 2015 of the Council and OM SR/S9/Z-09/2018 of DST dated 30.01.2019 Experience: 2 years of research experience (for candidates with 3 years Bachelor's and 2 years Master's degree, along with NET) Age limit: Maximum 35 for Male candidate, 40 for Female candidate Other conditions: Reservations and other rules & regulations as per ICAR/CAU norms Desirable: Published research papers Exposure to data analysis Knowledge of statistical analysis software packages Working knowledge of Greenhouse design software (Ansys)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual position in the AICRP-PEASEM project Appointment will be purely temporary Appointment may be terminated at any time without any notice or assigning any reason Remuneration stated for 1st, 2nd and 3rd years

content_sections.heading: How Will CAEPHT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Walk-in interview on 14-12-2026 at 10:30am
